name: Crypto exchange proof of reserves
access: Snapshot of on-chain holdings and liability data supplied by the exchange.
publication: Attestation letters published by the exchange.
ai_analogue: Voluntary assurance that collapsed after a failure: the attesting firms withdrew rather than deepen access. A live example of assurance retreating when the assessed party controls scope and data.

milestones.event: FTX collapse; a prior attestation had not covered liabilities.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Losses above $1B; prior attestation omitted liabilities

milestones.event: Accounting firms pause or withdraw proof-of-reserves work for crypto clients.
EU MiCA imposes safeguarding and reporting duties on crypto-asset service providers, applying from 2024.

status: seed; secondary sources, years spot-checked; verify against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Exchange picks and pays; attestations on exchange-supplied snapshots; MiCA adds custody duties.
